title: ContentTemplate
description: A saved starting point for generating something: what kind of piece, for which channel and objective, with the standing instructions to use. Settings somebody wants back, not a piece of content — nothing generated is kept here.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

session.description: The session the template belongs to, as the system that owns the session names it. Optional: scoping a template to a working session is how Creative Flow holds it, not part of what it is, and a system without sessions must be able to carry the same shape.

name.description: What the person called it, so they recognise it in a list.

generationType.description: What kind of piece it produces. Free text: the names belong to the generation flow, which adds to them.

channel.description: Where the piece is meant to run, in the words of whoever saved the template. Free text everywhere it appears: the vocabulary belongs to whoever publishes.

objective.description: What the piece is meant to do. Free text, for the same reason as channel.

instructions.description: The standing instructions to apply, in the person's own words. The template's substance: everything else only files it.
